title: 17-layer Al2O3/MgF2 defect cavity with tight refinement bounds around Round 2 optimum
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness perturbations to ±15% around the Round 2 optimal geometry (Candidate 2: thicknesses ~[81, 213, 198, 158, 140, 182, 141, 180, 147, 121, 129, 91, 124, 94, 204, 113, 96] nm) will enable gradient-based optimization to resolve finer sub-peaks in the local landscape that broad discovery bounds missed, improving target score beyond 0.5178.
design_principle: Local refinement search with reduced perturbation amplitude around verified optimum, preserving the 17-layer defect-cavity topology (8 pairs + 1 central cavity layer) that demonstrated 0.5178 score in Round 2.
proposed_topology: Air | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 (cavity) | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | Fused silica substrate (17 finite layers total, symmetric defect cavity centered on layer 9)
design_variables: 17 layer thicknesses with bounds centered on Round 2 optimum ±15%
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness precision affects cavity resonance position
theory_basis: Defect cavity in 1-D photonic crystal creates narrow transmission band within stopband
Local optimization converges faster when initialized near optimum with tight bounds
expected_advantages: Reduced risk of escaping proven high-performing region
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum if landscape is flat
Tight bounds may prevent discovery of better distant optima
execution_request_english: Optimize a 17-layer all-dielectric filter stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3 (17 finite layers). Initialize thicknesses centered on Round 2 optimum values [81.2, 213.3, 198.5, 157.8, 140.1, 182.3, 140.9, 179.6, 146.9, 121.1, 129.1, 90.8, 124.1, 94.4, 204.2, 112.6, 95.9] nm with ±15% perturbation bounds for each layer. Use coherent TMM solver. Optimize for maximum transmittance in 255-280 nm band and minimum transmittance in 300-700 nm and 700-1100 nm bands. Normal incidence, unpolarized light. No metal layers. Total layer count fixed at 17. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 255–280 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Transmittance in 300–700 nm; Transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers; No metal layers; Only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials.
revision_reason: Pivot from discovery search to refinement search per feedback directive. Constrain perturbations around Round 2 Candidate 2 optimum geometry with reduced amplitude (±15% vs previous broad bounds) to resolve deeper sub-peaks.
